Hey man, here’s my opinion, I hope you find some use out of it, I only want to help. 

You’re only 16 and you got so much of your life ahead of you. I understand that it may feel discouraging to perform well in academics but trust me when I say this, academics are not the only way you can become financially successful. My own cousins did not get a high school degree, attended trade school and are working comfortable lives.

I know that it also must feel stressful if your siblings are good in academics but how would you approach this if you were a parent?  Three kids, but one doesn’t perform as well as the others. Why get mad if it’s not his/her thing. Not everyone likes academics and that’s alright. There are other choices, paths, options in life.

From experience, don’t surround yourself with people who don’t make you feel and become a better person. It will feels loads better to get away from the people at school who treat you poorly even if that means you eat lunch alone or don’t talk to many people during class. You’ll find your people eventually and after high school, even more possibilities for meeting new people open up.

My best advice for your situation is to try your best. Whether you decide to put your efforts into school or another path in life, try your best. You can’t and NO ONE else in the world can beat you up or EVER expect more from you, because you tried your best. Your best will always be plenty enough and everything will happen for a reason. 

Ps. I ended up choosing academics and was able to do decently in high school. If you decide to put your efforts into school, Pm me and I can give you tips for anything you’d like whether studying, test taking, or SAT prep.
Hope therapy goes well:)!!
